completed_task_history.title: execute one paired seed case
completed_task_history.scope: Add a validated direct single-pair seed selector and a library/CLI path that prepares teams once and runs the base and seat-swapped battles sequentially, returning safe partial run records on failure.
exclusions: implicit root seed, pair index, suite size, or scored defaults
acceptance_criteria: generatePair validates and copies a dense four-limb uint16 root and zero-based pair index 0..99999 without materializing earlier cases; result equals the corresponding existing manifest entry and existing manifest behavior stays byte-compatible.

runPair prepares A/B once, runs base then swapped seats through existing runBattle with correct team/policy identities and battle seed, and returns a versioned trusted pair record with both validated records on success and safe honest partial states on failure.

Pair envelope includes pin, format, root, pair index/ID, team hashes/seeds, run IDs/seats/policy identities/statuses, monotonic elapsed scope covering preparation and both battles, and no raw exceptions, packets, transcripts, packed teams, or handles.

Preparation, first-run, and second-run failures stop dependent runs; preserve earlier successful record and actual safe runner failure record; never fabricate outcomes or trust foreign error metadata.
CLI requires explicit root and pair index, writes JSON success output, nonzero safe errors, and optional success/failure pair-result file; CLI parse/load/write behavior is explicit and tested.

Pinned real integration proves exactly two generation and pack calls, exchanged packed-team hashes, policy seed identity, valid outcomes, and projected policy inputs remain normal; fake tests cover partial failures and no extra runs.
README, charter and handoff distinguish one-pair execution from proposed suite execution/aggregation; affected suites, syntax, state/JSON, diff checks, Trail build/check pass; no GPU required.

review_corrections.finding: The library accepts a root seed array, but runPair used the CLI text parser, which accepts only comma-separated strings.

review_corrections.correction: Validate and copy the API array with validateSeed; keep text parsing at the CLI boundary.

review_corrections.finding: CLI bootstrap accepted arbitrary error.pairResult metadata when its kind matched, allowing foreign code to forge completed status and inject output fields.
review_corrections.evidence: Patched oracle.assertReady to throw an Error with pairResult.kind=gen5-paired-battle-result, status=completed, failure.code=INJECTED_PAIR_CODE, and foreignData=INJECTED_PAIR_DATA; prior main serialized the injected result.
review_corrections.correction: Use private pair-error branding and accept its record only after the actual runPair stage has started. Regression asserts safe nonzero CLI failure with injected metadata absent.

review_corrections.finding: Parse/bootstrap failures were labeled paired_runner with zero elapsed time although runPair had not begun.
review_corrections.evidence: Invalid-root CLI result had elapsedScope=paired_runner and elapsedMs=0.
review_corrections.correction: Measure CLI initialization monotonically and label it cli_initialization; preserve paired_runner timing for errors after invocation.

review_corrections.finding: Caller option getters and runBattle argument construction shared the catch that trusted error.resultRecord, so a throwing limits getter could forge a completed nested result and arbitrary failure category/code before runBattle was called.
review_corrections.evidence: A limits getter threw an Error with resultRecord={status:completed,failure:{category:INJECTED_CATEGORY,code:INJECTED_CODE},foreignData:INJECTED_RECORD}; prior output included the injected fields although runBattle was never invoked.
review_corrections.correction: Snapshot root/index/ps/limits/streamFactory in a configuration boundary, copy enumerable limits values into a plain object, and build plain battle args before a catch containing only the actual runBattle invocation. Throwing option getters produce safe configuration failures with both runs not_attempted and no nested result.
